key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for simplification and better implementation of EU single market rules while upholding core policy objectives.
Demands competitiveness checks in impact assessments and a stronger Regulatory Scrutiny Board.
Calls for a fitness check clarifying interplay of the AI Act, GDPR, DSA, Product Liability Directive and cybersecurity rules.
Supports regulatory sandboxes and iterative, co-regulatory approaches for emerging technologies.
Calls for harmonised enforcement, a revised Consumer Protection Cooperation Regulation and a revised New Legislative Framework.
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution of 11 September 2025 on implementing and streamlining EU internal market rules. It urges simplification, harmonised enforcement, competitiveness checks and SME support. It calls for a digital fitness check clarifying how the AI Act, GDPR, DSA and Product Liability Directive interact. It also backs regulatory sandboxes.
annotation.title_clean: Implementation and streamlining of EU internal market rules to strengthen the single market
